claimsBoundary: 합성 294건에서의 검색·경로 회수, 생산성 대리지표 및 서버측 함수 실행시간입니다. 실제 현업 시간 절감·생산성 향상이나 인과 정확도를 뜻하지 않습니다.
productivityProxyNotice: 문서 확인 수와 유효근거 밀도는 순위 기반 proxy입니다. 사용자의 읽기·판단 시간, 업무 완료 시간 또는 비용 절감으로 환산하지 않습니다.

metricDefinitions.recallAtK: top-K relevant unique IDs / 7 relevant IDs
metricDefinitions.directPathRecall: expected direct IDs returned with depth=1 / expected direct IDs
metricDefinitions.twoHopTargetRecall: expected targets returned with depth=2 / expected 2-hop targets
metricDefinitions.twoHopPathRecall: expected targets returned at depth=2 through an accepted via ID / expected 2-hop paths
metricDefinitions.distractorFalsePositiveRateAtK: nonrelevant IDs in returned top-K / returned top-K slots; false-discovery style, not classical corpus FPR
metricDefinitions.background270RateAtK: WS-025..WS-294 IDs in returned top-K / returned top-K slots
metricDefinitions.documentsToFirstGrade3Evidence: rank position of the first grade-3 evidence; document-count proxy, not elapsed time
metricDefinitions.documentsToAllGrade3Evidence: maximum rank needed to encounter every grade-3 evidence; null when any grade-3 evidence is unretrieved
metricDefinitions.validEvidenceDensityAt10: relevant IDs in returned top-10 / returned top-10 slots
metricDefinitions.grade3CoverageAt10: grade-3 IDs in returned top-10 / all grade-3 IDs
metricDefinitions.llmHistoryCountRatio: histories selected by actual buildIssueInsightContext / all 251 completed histories
metricDefinitions.llmContextCharRatio: characters in actual selected serialized context / characters in comparison context projecting all completed histories with the same excerpt limits; not a token or cost ratio
metricDefinitions.runtime: server-side function time after five warm-ups; excludes file IO, network, and UI rendering
